name: mdx-message-agent-noise-policy
human_line: Agents are useful in the room, never the room itself. Their posts fold by default past a threshold, expand in place, and always say what kind of actor wrote them.
lane_source: actor_id prefix (agent:, pipeline:, system:, worker:) - the write records it, the surface derives it, nothing is guessed

folding.behavior: three or more consecutive non-human posts fold into one run row with actor names and a count; expand and fold in place

rich_bodies.markdown: escape-first renderer shared with Twin (XSS structurally impossible)
rich_bodies.decision_card: bodies shaped 'Decision: ...' (the governed record_decision output) render as a decision card with title, detail, and why

declared_slots_for_admin.per_channel_agent_posting_policy: not built - the workspace-level toggle ships first
